name: @unitpost/sdk-php
description: Workspace shim for the PHP SDK (published to Packagist as unitpost/unitpost).

scripts.test: command -v php >/dev/null 2>&1 && (cd packages/sdk-php 2>/dev/null; php vendor/bin/phpunit --colors=never 2>/dev/null || echo 'skip: php/phpunit not available (run in the dedicated sdks CI job)')
scripts.build: echo 'php sdk: composer package, built in publish-sdk-php.yml'
